name: AI suggestion
summary: A suggested rewrite of one sentence inside a text field, shown as a diff with the reason and where it came from, to accept, reject or swap for another.
use: when an assistant proposes an edit a person should accept or reject
a11y: Removed and added words use del and ins; the buttons are real buttons, the result is announced in a status line with focus moved to Undo, and the alternative count is a polite live region.

use_when: a writing assistant that offers two or more rewrites of the same sentence, one at a time
avoid_when: the assistant answers a question rather than editing the person's text: use chat-answer
many edits across a long document at once: list them in a review panel instead of one card per sentence

parts.name: label
parts.what: what the text field is, above it

parts.name: field
parts.what: the person's text, a few short paragraphs

parts.name: target
parts.what: the one sentence the suggestion would replace, highlighted

parts.name: count
parts.what: which alternative is showing, as '1 of 2'

parts.name: diffs
parts.what: one alternative rewrite, removed words struck and added words marked; only one shows at a time

parts.name: note
parts.what: where a fact came from and how sure the assistant is, after an icon

parts.name: accept
parts.what: puts the rewrite into the text

parts.name: result
parts.what: the status line after accepting or rejecting

parts.name: undo
parts.what: brings the original sentence and the card back

empty.how: the Smart UI renderer puts one plain 'Nothing to show yet.' line in an empty list

loading.how: the Smart UI renderer draws each marked slot as a quiet block of its size while the data arrives; the static file shows the filled part

error.how: if no rewrite comes back, put a short line in the done status row ('Could not suggest an edit') with a retry button in place of Undo

disabled.how: while a choice is being saved, set disabled on Try another, Reject and Accept

overflow.how: the buttons wrap, and in a narrow box Try another takes its own row

long_text.how: the highlighted sentence keeps its rounded highlight on every line it wraps to; button labels never wrap

keyboard: Tab reaches Try another, Reject, then Accept
Enter or Space presses the focused button
After Accept or Reject, focus moves to Undo; Undo puts focus back on Accept
